# seo-rea

> Evidence-first SEO and AI-search teardown CLI, MCP server and agent skill. Given a domain it writes a Strategy Dossier on why the site leads (cluster map, programmatic SEO, head-term rankings, drivers, playbook, 30/60/90 plan, optional --vs comparison). Given a keyword and a domain it records who ranks, parses their pages, validates JSON-LD, checks AI-crawler access and llms.txt, computes a TF-IDF keyword gap, looks up competitor ads, and writes a report where every claim cites saved evidence (E001, E002, ...). Free sources first; paid calls are refused at the default budget of 0 USD.

Install: `npx seo-rea <domain> [--vs <domain>]` or `npx seo-rea teardown --keyword "<kw>" --target <domain> --out <dir>`. MCP: `npx -y seo-rea mcp` (stdio). Node 22+.
